name: Zynga Poker – Texas Holdem
description:
THE WORLD’S LARGEST POKER GAME IS COMING TO STEAM!

Join the world’s most popular free-to-play poker game and experience more tables, tournaments, and jackpots than ever before!

FREE CHIPS:

Start your poker journey with a generous 13,000,000 FREE CHIP welcome bonus! Whether you're new to poker or a seasoned player, our casual atmosphere and daily rewards up to 45,000,000 chips to keep your chip stack growing and the action rolling.

TEXAS HOLD EM YOUR WAY:

Keep it casual with a classic, free Texas Hold'em game, or turn up the heat and amp up the excitement by chasing those high-stakes jackpots. The choice is yours!

POT-LIMIT OMAHA POKER:

Unlock a whole new card game! Pot-limit Omaha is one of our favorite new game modes. Dive into a whole new card game! Pot-limit Omaha adds more action with FOUR hole cards, letting you create bigger and better hands.

FAIR PLAY:

Play with complete confidence where fairness and security are the highest priority. Zynga Poker™ is officially certified to play like a real table experience. Take your online poker games anywhere and know that you’re getting the true Vegas-style card game. Zynga Poker prides itself on being a fair and trusted gaming platform, which is why the card dealing algorithm, or Random Number Generator (RNG), utilized in our game is Gaming Labs Certified by Gaming Laboratories International, a leading independent certification agency for the gaming industry. We offer support at every stage of the game, so you can feel safe and protected.

VARIETY:

Join a Sit n Go game or a casual online poker game and win generous in-game payouts! Whether you prefer 5-player or 9-player tables, fast or slow games, you can find the perfect match.

SOCIAL POKER EXPERIENCE:

Challenge your friends to poker games, practice your poker face, meet new friends online and become a poker star! Zynga Poker has the strongest community of any poker game.

HIGHER STAKES, BIGGER PAYOUTS:

With higher buy-ins, you can win even more virtual poker chips in every tournament you play.

FASTER TOURNAMENTS:

Join to compete at the traditional 9-person table game or try the new 5-person table for quicker play.

MULTI-TABLE TOURNAMENTS:

Participate in Multi-Table Tournaments (MTTs), a popular poker format often seen on TV, where players compete against hundreds or even thousands of opponents across multiple tables. MTTs provide the thrill of competing for a massive top prize with a relatively small buy-in.

THE “TRILLIONAIRE MAKER”:

The Trillionaire Maker is Zynga Poker’s marquee Multi-Table Tournament! The Trillionaire Maker event guarantees a first-place prize of TRILLIONS OF CHIPS! Winning in this event will not only send your chip stack into the stratosphere, but will also allow you to play in some of the highest stakes games that Zynga Poker has to offer.

VIP PROGRAM:

Climb the ranks in our VIP Program to earn in-game perks, benefits and free poker features! Enjoy exclusive chip packages and special game modes.

LEAGUES:

Join millions of players worldwide in our online Poker Season competition. Win the most chips to rise to the top and become the Texas Poker champion!

PLAY ANYWHERE:

Take your favorite poker game with you wherever you go! Play seamlessly across all platforms.

Zynga Poker is the go-to destination for video poker players, social casino fans, tournament enthusiasts, and tabletop players. If you love the Vegas casino experience and vibe, you’ll feel right at home in our friendly poker community!
